Minor wording: decisions/RT-FIX-P6-latex.md says the click 'awaits its answer together with the import() of export.ts'. ToolFrame.onExportLatex in fact awaits the tool's answer first and then imports export.ts, so the first click makes two fetches one after the other. Behaviour is correct.

Minor, unreachable today: ToolFrame now passes a latexForExport answer of undefined on as undefined, which makes latexDownload use the default \dynkin. The base showed the notice in that case. The type allows only LatexChoice or null and no tool returns undefined, so nothing changes in practice.

Note, not a defect: T12's export reads the full orbit at the click. While the drawing is still being put in layer by layer (a few frames after a pick), the file can hold more than is drawn on screen at that moment.
